title: Arrow owner fix
description: Fixes Arrows sometimes loosing ownership when logging off the server.
body:
In 1.21.6 Mojang made some changes to arrows, making them sometimes loose all data (including their owner) when the owner is offline. This breaks some cool contraptions like Squibbles Mirror pylon.

This Datapack restores the Owner data if lost, fixing this completely.
Probably not recommend this for larger servers.
